❓ Welcome to Liminal Core! ❓
Immerse yourself in the surreal and eerie world of liminal spaces. Liminal Core offers a unique exploration experience that combines the strange and unsettling with a place to hang out and delve into the unknown

•  📝 Notes:
    •     WARNING - This game contains jumpscares and photosensitivity.
    •     If you enjoy playing, please leave a thumbs up. Thank you!
    •     Join the community server for updates & sneakpeaks!
    •     Update Logs - Available at [Nexus Arc] (Group)

•  💰 Perks:
    •     Join at 'Nexus Arc' For 200 Cash! | Premium Benefits: `200 Cash` | Group + Premium = '400 Cash' 

•  🎮 Controls:
    •     PC: Hold 'Shift' to sprint | Mobile/Tablet: Use the 'Sprint' button | Consoles: Press 'LT' to sprint

•  🖥 Supported Devices:
    •     PC, Mobile, Console, VR

•  🎵 Soundtracks:
    •     by 4angelz
